name: South Eastern Coalfields
bear: Margins far below MCL (~13% FY25 vs 35%) due to underground mines and a large workforce.
Profit volatility: PAT fell from Rs 6,877 cr (FY24) to ~Rs 4,650 cr (FY25).
Timeline slippage risk — 25% OFS + 10% fresh is a large supply overhang.
bull: Only CIL arm growing production, offtake and OB in FY26.
Gevra/Kusmunda mega-mine expansion; largest reserve base in CIL.
Fresh-issue component gives growth capital, unlike MCL.
business: South Eastern Coalfields Ltd (Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh) is CIL's second-largest producer, with mixed opencast/underground operations across Korba (Gevra — world's second-largest coal mine, Kusmunda, Dipka) and Central India Coalfields; reserves ~90 BT (Apr 2023), ~25% of CIL's reserve base. Higher cost structure than MCL due to underground mines and ~60,000 workforce.

financials.note: PAT per CIL CMD (31 Aug 2026); revenue not disclosed.
Per ipoji compilation; Upstox cites FY25 PAT Rs 4,545 cr — unverified against annual report.
Revenue from operations Rs 27,255.2 cr, PAT Rs 6,877.5 cr (Grokipedia/annual report).

flags: Government pricing and PSU governance as with MCL.
Fresh-issue dilution; use of proceeds unspecified.

issue.objects: Up to 25% OFS by Coal India plus fresh issue of up to 10% of post-issue paid-up capital (structure approved in principle by CIL board, Mar/Aug 2026); fresh proceeds for expansion (Gevra/Kusmunda/Dipka capacity, evacuation).
sellers: Coal India Ltd — up to 25% OFS (share count TBD)
issue.shareholderQuota: Not yet disclosed; CIL precedent is 10% of issue for Coal India shareholders.

logistics: Same expected mechanics as MCL: 1 COALINDIA share on the RHP record date likely qualifies for any shareholder quota; not yet confirmed.
metrics: 176.29 MT (+5.3% YoY; only CIL arm to grow on all three parameters)

street.view: SECL IPO (25% OFS + up to 10% fresh) to be completed within FY27.

timeline.expectedWindow: CIL CMD (31 Aug 2026): IPO to be completed within FY27, timing subject to market conditions and government directives; DRHP expected after MCL's.

valuation.impliedMcapNote: No size guidance yet; at Coal India's ~8.3x P/E FY26 PAT Rs 4,755 cr implies ~Rs 39,000-40,000 cr equity value.
